fallon_nv.headline: Over these years the optimised plan would give 168 mm less irrigation per year. Trade-off: $729/ha less indicative margin.
fallon_nv.method: Differences between the two plans as simulated at this field (FieldShift season model, NASA POWER weather). CO₂e counts only the direct N₂O emissions of fertiliser not applied (IPCC 2019, EF1 = 1 %, GWP100 = 273, AR6); manufacturing emissions are not counted. Margins use this country's producer prices and modelled costs (see economics).
